seqkit split2 \
  -1 /Users/chris/fastq_out/Pat4_rep1_blood_0_1_H3HNYBGXB/concatfastq/bamtofastq/bamtofastq_S1_L001_R1_001.fastq.gz \
  -2 /Users/chris/fastq_out/Pat4_rep1_blood_0_1_H3HNYBGXB/concatfastq/bamtofastq/bamtofastq_S1_L001_R2_001.fastq.gz\
  -s 1000000 \
  -O chunks
  
seqkit replace -p '^.*$' -r 'read_{nr}' \
  reads.fastq.gz -o renamed.fastq.gz
  
  
## replace read names running number and leading zeros

seqkit replace -p '^.*$' -r 'read_{nr}' --nr-width 10 \
  /Users/chris/fastq_out/Pat4_rep1_blood_0_1_H3HNYBGXB/concatfastq/bamtofastq/bamtofastq_S1_L001_R1_001.fastq.gz \
  -o /Users/chris/fastq_out/Pat4_rep1_blood_0_1_H3HNYBGXB/concatfastq/bamtofastq/bamtofastq_S1_L001_R1_001_renamed.fastq.gz
  
  

## two options to replace quality values with a constant (both take a while)
## try this for R2 only. barcodes in R1 may be subject to correction based on quality.

seqkit fx2tab /Users/chris/fastq_out/Pat4_rep1_blood_0_1_H3HNYBGXB/concatfastq/bamtofastq/bamtofastq_S1_L001_R2_001_renamed.fastq.gz \
  | awk 'BEGIN {FS=OFS="\t"} {gsub(/./, "I", $3); print}' \
  | seqkit tab2fx -o /Users/chris/fastq_out/Pat4_rep1_blood_0_1_H3HNYBGXB/concatfastq/bamtofastq/bamtofastq_S1_L001_R2_001_renamed_constant.fastq.gz
  

gzip -dc /Users/chris/fastq_out/Pat4_rep1_blood_0_1_H3HNYBGXB/concatfastq/bamtofastq/bamtofastq_S1_L001_R2_001_renamed.fastq.gz \
  | LC_ALL=C awk 'NR % 4 == 0 {gsub(/./, "I")} {print}' \
  | pigz -1 -p 8 > /Users/chris/fastq_out/Pat4_rep1_blood_0_1_H3HNYBGXB/concatfastq/bamtofastq/bamtofastq_S1_L001_R2_001_renamed_constant.fastq.gz

 /Users/chris/fastq_out2/Pat4_rep1_blood_S1_L001_R1_002.fastq.gz \
    --rename --level 1

 /Users/chris/fastq_out2/Pat4_rep1_blood_S1_L001_R2_002.fastq.gz \

# multithreaded?
set -o pipefail

input="/Users/chris/fastq_out/Pat4_rep1_blood_0_1_H3HNYBGXB/concatfastq/bamtofastq/bamtofastq_S1_L001_R2_001_renamed.fastq.gz"
output="${input%.fastq.gz}_constant.fastq.gz"

gzip -dc "$input" \
  | parallel --pipe -L 4 --block 64M -j 4 --keep-order \
      "LC_ALL=C awk 'NR % 4 == 0 {gsub(/./, \"I\")} {print}'" \
  | pigz -1 -p 8 > "$output"
  
  

  
ls -lhSr /Users/chris/fastq_out/Pat4_rep1_blood_0_1_H3HNYBGXB/concatfastq/bamtofastq
